title: Jump Game

examples.explanation: In the first case you can step from index 0 to 1, then from 1 to 4. In the second, index 3 has a jump length of zero and blocks the way to index 4.

constraints: Each jump length is between 0 and 100,000.
You may jump fewer steps than the number allows, including zero.
Reaching the last index is the goal; you do not need to stop exactly on it from a jump that overshoots.
